headline: Bank of England chief exits IMF meeting over Russia
standfirst: Andrew Bailey joined a protest against Russian involvement during a finance summit.

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: Bank of England governor Andrew Bailey walked out of an IMF meeting in Bangkok.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: The exit was a protest against the Russian finance minister speaking to the group.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: It shows finance leaders are using their presence to signal opposition to Russia.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: Future international summits to see if these protests continue or escalate.

caption:
Bank of England governor Andrew Bailey walked out of an IMF meeting in protest against Russia.

Bailey was among several finance leaders who left the session as the Russian finance minister began to address the group. This move highlights the ongoing diplomatic tensions within global financial institutions.
